items.name: Traveler's Pack
items.description: A worn canvas pack with good straps — bedroll, flint, mess kit, fifty small comforts of the road.

items.name: Waterskin
items.description: Boiled and refilled at the last clean spring. Worth more every week the river runs gray.

items.name: Belt Knife
items.description: A plain working blade — more tool than weapon, but it has been both.

items.name: Hemp Rope (30 ft)
items.description: Tarred hemp, knotted every arm's length. The difference between a fall and a climb.

items.name: Resonance Lantern
items.description: Harmonic-made: a phononic crystal that glows when it sings. Light without flame, and it hums louder near active nanite fields.
items.substrateNote: A phononic crystal that glows when it sings; singing is a draw on the lattice and the crystal stays warm.

items.name: Medic's Satchel
items.description: Herb rolls, boiled linen, needle and gut. Valley medicine — patient, practical, proven.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: Bitter green tincture from the terrace gardens. Knits small wounds and dulls big ones.

items.name: Dried Rations
items.description: Fish, fruit leather, hard bread. Two days if you're honest with yourself, three if you're not.

items.name: Prism Chip
items.description: A thumb-sized shard of Radiant photonic crystal. Splits any light into telltale spectra — a poor man's Prism Sight.
items.substrateNote: Radiant photonic crystal. A small shard holds a small charge.

items.name: Trade Tokens
items.description: Stamped ceramic rounds honored in Millbrook and grudgingly beyond. The valley's compromise with currency.

items.name: Keystone Shard
items.description: A palm-sized wedge of Precursor keystone, warm on the flat and cold on the broken edge. It answers structured intent the way the lattice does, because it is a piece of it.
items.substrateNote: ⛔ PRECURSOR charge. It carries dense ground WITH you — a lattice-worker holding one is less starved in thin country, and only for as long as the shard lasts. ⚠️ It does nothing for a Reaching Mind, who wants the ground quiet; carrying one is interference to them. Cannot be recharged by anyone living.

items.name: Pre-Transition Cell
items.description: A sealed grey canister the length of a forearm, stamped with a maker's mark nobody can read. Ordered nanite, held in reserve. The fill-line still shows three-quarters — but the line measures how much is still STRUCTURED, not how much is still there.
items.substrateNote: ⛔ NANITE charge, and the one source that TRAVELS: a cell works as well on a bare mountain as in a lattice hollow, because nanite answers to supply, not to ground. ⚠️ IT DOES NOT DEPLETE — it goes WILD. What you spend is spent into purpose and scatters into the field around you, still there and no longer yours. ⛔ So a used cell leaves a WAKE: the ground where a nanite-worker has been working hard is wilder than it was, which is good for a Churnfolk and bad for the next Vested to pass through. A cell can be refilled — by processing wild nanite back to structure, which is an industry, and someone controls it.

items.name: Snarl Bead
items.description: A knot of something that was once ordered, fused into a bead the colour of oil on water. It is never quite the same temperature twice and it is never quite still.
items.substrateNote: ⚠️ WILD charge — ungoverned nanite, bound into a bead by someone brave or careless. It widens BOTH crit bands for whoever carries it: your best results get better and your worst get worse, and you do not choose which arrives. ⛔ The Churnfolk sell these cheerfully and will not take one back.

items.name: Quiet Stone
items.description: A river-smoothed stone with a thumb-hollow worn into it by long holding. Held, it makes the ground around you quieter than it is. Not empty — QUIETING.
items.substrateNote: ⛔ NEGATIVE charge, ON PURPOSE — it OFFSETS the ground rather than adding to it. Metaphysical craft wants thin ground and treats a dense lattice as apparatus standing in the way, so a Quiet Stone does not carry power: it carries QUIET, thinning what is around the holder by roughly the width of a room. ⚠️ THE EXACT INVERSE OF THE KEYSTONE SHARD — a shard brings dense ground with you; a stone takes it away. ⛔ AND IT IS RUDE TO CARRY UNANNOUNCED: standing next to a lattice-worker with one in your pocket is standing in their light. It also cannot be drained, because there is nothing in it to take.

items.name: The Far Token
items.description: A coin-weight of something that is not metal, marked on one face and blank on the other, and the blank face is the one that is hard to look at. It is cold in a way that does not warm to the hand.
items.substrateNote: ⛔ VEIL charge — a thing from the far side of a defensive work, and it is powered by an ABSENCE. It thins the membrane around whoever carries it: good ground for the Beyond-Facing and for Far Terms, ⚠️ and quietly bad for anyone lattice-dependent standing nearby. ⛔ IT WORKS BOTH WAYS. Something knows where the token is, and a token that has been carried a long time is a token that has been noticed. The Bargainers price these honestly and most of them will not hold one overnight.

items.name: Warden's Ash
items.description: A twist of grey powder in waxed paper — the residue of something an Ashwarden attended all the way to its end, kept because an ending witnessed properly leaves something behind.
items.substrateNote: ⚠️ Scattered over a body or a threshold, it makes an ending HARDER TO INTERFERE WITH — a pattern less easily archived by the lattice, less easily pulled across by what waits beyond. ⛔ It does not preserve anyone and it does not bring anyone back. It buys a natural ending its natural path, which the Ashwardens hold is the whole of the work. Used up in one scattering.

_carriedPowerNote: SNG-381: items that carry a POWER SOURCE, one per ratified source. ⛔ The source is stated in `substrateNote` PROSE rather than a `chargeSource` field, deliberately — the note reaches play today and a new field would have no reader (SNG-380). ⚠️ When substrate.js can take a typed charge, promote these notes to `chargeSource` and the prose stays as flavour. ⚠️ NOTE `quiet_stone` carries charge 0 ON PURPOSE: metaphysical craft is the source that wants LESS, and an item expressing that is more interesting than one more battery.
